Gargoyle.description: Reinforced with heavy stone plates and thick iron staples.

features.name: Gargoyle Stitch Flesh
features.tldr: You gain extra armor density that reduces physical slashing and piercing damage.

Galvanized.description: Wired with conductive copper channels and energized by residual electrical sparks.

features.name: Galvanized Stitch Flesh
features.tldr: You gain resistance to electricity and can discharge static shocks in close combat.
